tasks.verified: The patient's verbatim day-part (morning/afternoon/evening) becomes a deterministic time window whenever extraction dropped it: 'Friday afternoon' can never again return morning slots, proven at the handler seam with the cumulative suite grown past 134 tests.
tasks.spec:
ROLE: fix worker for the Mott booking gateway, lane 56 (verbatim day-part authority). Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills, no deploys, do not load skills.

CONTEXT - measured live defect from a patient test, reproduced deterministically via envelope capture: the patient wrote 'Friday afternoon'. The LLM extractor emitted preference_from='friday' and time_after='none' - the word 'afternoon' was dropped entirely - so the gateway returned the day's EARLIEST slots (11:00 am) and the bot offered morning times to a patient who asked for the afternoon, twice in one conversation. Design rule of this system: extraction nondeterminism must never be load-bearing; the gateway receives user_text and user_verbatim on every availability request and the patient's verbatim is the authority (this is the fourth fix in that family, after lanes 52, 54 and 55).

SOURCE - copy /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW55/gw-verbatim-date-authority/fixed-bland_gateway.py (the lane-55 artifact: lane-51 meridiem inference, lane-52 resolve_anaphoric_week, lane-53 vocab, lane-54 verbatim meridiem authority + closed_day, lane-55 verbatim ordinal/that-weekday authority) into your CWD as fixed-bland_gateway.py and edit that copy. Copy the cumulative test tree /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW55/gw-verbatim-date-authority/gwtest into ./gwtest and extend it; every existing test must still pass.

THE FIX - VERBATIM DAY-PART AUTHORITY at the handler-level window seam (where after/before are applied):
1. TRIGGER (all required): (a) user_verbatim or user_text contains a day-part word - morning, afternoon, evening, tonight, night (case-insensitive, whole word) - not preceded by the word 'good' (greetings like 'good afternoon' must not trigger); (b) the request carries NO explicit time window - after is none/empty AND before is none/empty; (c) time_pref carries no anchor (an explicit clock ask outranks a day-part).
2. ACTION - apply the day-part as a deterministic window on the resolved day(s): morning -> before 12:00 pm; afternoon -> after 12:00 pm; evening/tonight/night -> after 4:00 pm. Apply through the SAME mechanism the existing after/before parameters use, so ordering, grid and satisfiability behavior are inherited unchanged.
3. NON-TRIGGERS (behavior byte-identical): extraction already set after or before; time_pref has an anchor or latest; verbatim has no day-part word; the only day-part word is in a 'good <daypart>' greeting.
4. PRECEDENCE with prior lanes: day-part windowing composes with (does not replace) date resolution from lanes 52/53/55; if both a day-part and an explicit clock time appear in the verbatim, the clock time (anchor path) wins and the day-part is ignored.
5. Implement the day-part detection + window mapping as a pure function taking (verbatim_text, after, before, time_pref) and returning the effective (after, before), so tests drive it directly; the handler calls it at the seam real requests traverse.

DELIVERABLES in CWD:
- fixed-bland_gateway.py (full edited file)
- proof_daypart.py - executable proof at the handler-level seam. Print exactly:
  CASE=afternoon-dropped AFTER=12:00 (from='friday', verbatim='Friday afternoon', after='none', before='none', time_pref='none')
  CASE=morning-window BEFORE=12:00 (from='saturday', verbatim='saturday morning', same none-params)
  CASE=evening-window AFTER=16:00 (from='thursday', verbatim='Thursday evening', same none-params)
  CASE=explicit-after-kept AFTER=15:00 (from='friday', verbatim='Friday afternoon', after='03:00 pm' - extraction window wins, no override)
  CASE=anchor-outranks AFTER=none (from='friday', verbatim='friday afternoon at 2', time_pref='anchor=2:00' - anchor path, no day-part window)
  CASE=greeting-not-trigger AFTER=none (from='friday', verbatim='good afternoon, do you have friday?', no window applied)
- ./gwtest extended with at least 7 new tests covering the three windows, both non-triggers, the greeting guard, and one end-to-end handler test proving a 'Friday afternoon' request returns no slot earlier than 12:00 pm.
- DEBUG-GW56.md - what changed, where, the exact detection regex, window mapping table, known limitations.

HARD RULES: do not weaken, remove or skip any existing test; keep all lane-51/52/53/54/55 behavior intact; keep the file runnable as the single gateway module it is; no placeholder code.
tasks.check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 ./proof_daypart.py > proof.out 2>&1 || { echo 'FAIL: proof crashed'; tail -8 proof.out; exit 1; }; for c in 'CASE=afternoon-dropped AFTER=12:00' 'CASE=morning-window BEFORE=12:00' 'CASE=evening-window AFTER=16:00' 'CASE=explicit-after-kept AFTER=15:00' 'CASE=anchor-outranks AFTER=none' 'CASE=greeting-not-trigger AFTER=none'; do grep -q "$c" proof.out || { echo "FAIL: missing $c"; cat proof.out; exit 1; }; done; grep -q 'resolve_anaphoric_week' fixed-bland_gateway.py && grep -q 'closed_day' fixed-bland_gateway.py || { echo 'FAIL: prior lane behavior lost'; exit 1; }; cd gwtest && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q > ../pytest.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cd ..; summary=$(tail -1 pytest.out); [ $rc -eq 0 ] || { echo "FAIL: suite red: $summary"; tail -10 pytest.out; exit 1; }; n=$(echo "$summary" | grep -oE '^[0-9]+'); [ "$n" -ge 134 ] || { echo "FAIL: only $n tests, floor is 134 (127 cumulative + 7 new)"; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: day-part authority proven - $summary"
